description: Approve (and execute) or reject a parked tool call from list_pending_tool_calls. On approve, the original tool call is actually run and its result stored/returned; on reject, it's just marked rejected — nothing runs.

approve.description: true = approve and run the parked call, false = reject it

human_request.description: Only for calls that normally need a human in the app (e.g. publishing in the video library): the human's own words asking for this approval, quoted verbatim. Works only with a person's own API key (not bound to an agent) and an admin role; it is written to the audit log.

name: resolve_pending_tool_call
